verdict.rationale: The only versioning signal is that the Microsoft Graph API used to manage Entra (single endpoint graph.microsoft.com) appears under a versioned docs view ('graph-rest-1.0'). That implies a versioned API surface but documents nothing about it. No evidence describes a deprecation policy, support windows, or breaking-change commitments. Missing for 10: an explicit API versioning scheme (e.g., v1.0 vs beta semantics), a documented deprecation/retirement policy with timelines, and independent corroboration.
